# Dunixab

> Dunixab is an animation movie production company founded in March 2025 in Neyyattinkara, Trivandrum (Kerala, India). It develops and produces its own animated feature films, short films, series, documentaries and short stories in 2D and 3D, with the visual effects (VFX) made in-house. It also creates animation and VFX for other companies.

- Website: https://www.dunixab.com/
- Email: contact@dunixab.com
- Phone: +91 96336 54296
- Location: Neyyattinkara, Trivandrum, Kerala, India (https://maps.app.goo.gl/PhottyUTh57yYwAa6)
- Social: https://www.linkedin.com/company/dunixab, https://www.facebook.com/dunixab, https://www.instagram.com/dunixab, https://x.com/dunixab, https://www.youtube.com/@dunixabstudio
